name: Ranger 6
about: Ranger 6 (1964-007A, NASA/JPL), launched 1964 Jan 30. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
